title: Microsoft 365 calendar integration
description: Live free/busy availability and automatic interview event management on Microsoft 365 and Outlook calendars, with per-interviewer OAuth and scoped access.

faq.q: Which Microsoft calendars does the integration cover?
faq.a: Any calendar on a Microsoft 365 work account, including Outlook calendars, connected per-interviewer through the standard Microsoft sign-in and consent flow.

faq.q: Can a panel mix Microsoft 365 and Google Calendar interviewers?
faq.a: Yes. Cadence computes the availability intersection across providers, so mixed panels schedule exactly like single-provider ones.
